g.text: Bundled raw pvalue: unadjusted candidate screening, not FDR-confirmed findings.
All 11765 features shown; Negative/Positive meet pvalue < 0.05 and |effect| >= 2; Other fails either rule.
7 labels: pvalue < 0.05 and |effect| >= 4; labels are candidates, not validated biomarkers.
Effect direction needs a defined contrast; input design and model are unverified.
